audit_name: Broker Execution Lifecycle & Durability Code Review

lifecycle_stages.name: Order Reservation
lifecycle_stages.findings: Checks is_executed(); verifies fencing generation counter; inserts row with status='RESERVED', unique token RES_GEN{gen}_{hex}, and 10.0s TTL. Enforces mutual exclusion under cross_process_lock.

lifecycle_stages.name: Sizing & Parameter Guard
lifecycle_stages.findings: Enforces discrete integer lots; strictly allows APPROVED_MAX_PAPER_LOTS == 1. Rejects float, NaN, inf, None, bool, negative, and oversized lots (>1) with PositionSizeViolation. Zero silent clamping.

lifecycle_stages.name: Write-Ahead Intent
lifecycle_stages.findings: Durably logs status='EXECUTING' to SQLite WAL with full intent payload (pos, order_id, trade_id, cash_outflow, fee) before mutating in-memory or JSON state. Fails and releases reservation if SQLite intent logging fails.

lifecycle_stages.name: Atomic State Persistence
lifecycle_stages.findings: Mutates in-memory broker state (cash, fees, position, last_order, processed_keys); writes to state.json.tmp; flushes OS cache via os.fsync(f.fileno()); performs atomic replace via os.replace(tmp, state_file).

lifecycle_stages.name: SQLite Commit Transition
lifecycle_stages.findings: Transitions SQLite status from 'EXECUTING' to 'COMMITTED'; sets expires_at=NULL; updates updated_at. Commits under PRAGMA synchronous = FULL;.

lifecycle_stages.name: Crash Recovery Reconciliation
lifecycle_stages.findings: On startup, queries get_pending_intents() for 'EXECUTING' rows. If matching position/order exists in state.json, transitions to 'COMMITTED'. If position was never persisted, transitions to 'ROLLED_BACK'. Completely eliminates partial-execution crash window.

durability_and_connection_hygiene.connection_teardown: Deterministic close in try/finally blocks and explicit reg.close() preventing Windows [WinError 32] file handle leaks.
durability_and_connection_hygiene.fail_closed_guarantee: Raises IdempotencyRegistryError and halts startup if database was corrupted and persistent state file contains zero historical trades.
